drafted_from: tool:keep-an-ai-activity-row's own row (its words, input schema and steps) from the activity library, tools/shared-code/src/activity.mjs (keepActivity); read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep what my AI did in my own database", with the database and the row it needs.
no_lists_because: It keeps AI activity rows in the person's own database, named by the database given; it names no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep what my AI did in my own database", and give it database (the person's own pursuit database, such as ethos_for_who_runs_it) and the row one AI call left.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-an-ai-activity-row and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: it answers the generation and seq the row was kept at. The tables are made in that database the first time.

4. Or hand it one raw tool call the AI made (call: tool, at, input, result, error, app) and the access the person holds: the activity marks decide the row it leaves, and a call that leaves none answers kept false with why.
